landvault
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_restructures ( id uuid NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id uuid, branch_id uuid, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp(6) with time zone, created_by varchar(255), updated_by varchar(255), deleted boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
transaction_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), seller_tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id), buyer_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), status varchar(16) NOT NULL, request_reason varchar(500) NOT NULL, preferred_instalments integer, requested_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL,
proposed_by uuid REFERENCES users (id), proposed_at timestamp(6) with time zone, from_schedule_version integer, instalment_count integer, frequency varchar(16), first_due_date date, balance numeric(19, 2), carried_penalty numeric(19, 2), expires_on date, letter_id uuid, letter_number varchar(32), transaction_reference varchar(32), plan_name varchar(120), plot_label varchar(255), estate_name varchar(255), lapse_reminder_sent_at timestamp(6) with time zone,
accepted_at timestamp(6) with time zone, accepted_user_agent varchar(255), to_schedule_version integer,
closed_at timestamp(6) with time zone, closed_by uuid REFERENCES users (id), close_note varchar(500),
CONSTRAINT chk_plan_restructures_status CHECK (status IN ('REQUESTED', 'PROPOSED', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'DECLINED', 'CANCELLED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'LAPSED')), CONSTRAINT chk_plan_restructures_preferred CHECK (preferred_instalments IS NULL OR preferred_instalments BETWEEN 1 AND 60), CONSTRAINT chk_plan_restructures_proposal CHECK (status IN ('REQUESTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED') OR (proposed_at IS NOT NULL AND instalment_count BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND frequency IN ('MONTHLY', 'QUARTERLY') AND first_due_date IS NOT NULL AND balance > 0 AND carried_penalty >= 0 AND expires_on IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT chk_plan_restructures_accepted CHECK ((status = 'ACCEPTED') = (accepted_at IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT chk_plan_restructures_open CHECK ((status IN ('REQUESTED', 'PROPOSED')) = (closed_at IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT chk_plan_restructures_rejection CHECK (status <> 'REJECTED' OR close_note IS NOT NULL) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_plan_restructures_one_open ON plan_restructures (transaction_id) WHERE status IN ('REQUESTED', 'PROPOSED') AND deleted = false; CREATE INDEX idx_plan_restructures_transaction ON plan_restructures (transaction_id, created_at); CREATE INDEX idx_plan_restructures_seller ON plan_restructures (seller_tenant_id, status); REVOKE DELETE, TRUNCATE ON plan_restructures FROM ${appDbUsername}; COMMENT ON TABLE plan_restructures IS 'Phase 5c: a buyer asking for their remaining instalments to be spread differently. REQUESTED, then REJECTED or CANCELLED, or PROPOSED (the developer''s new terms and the letter), then ACCEPTED, DECLINED, WITHDRAWN or LAPSED (14 days). The total owed never changes. One open per plan. Never deleted.';
CREATE TABLE plan_restructure_instalments ( id uuid NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, created_by varchar(255),
restructure_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_restructures (id), sequence integer NOT NULL, due_date date NOT NULL, amount numeric(19, 4) NOT NULL, carried_penalty numeric(19, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
CONSTRAINT uq_plan_restructure_instalments UNIQUE (restructure_id, sequence), CONSTRAINT chk_plan_restructure_instalments_amount CHECK (amount > 0 AND carried_penalty >= 0) ); REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON plan_restructure_instalments FROM ${appDbUsername}; COMMENT ON TABLE plan_restructure_instalments IS 'Phase 5c: a proposal''s new instalments, fixed when proposed and applied unchanged if accepted. Never changed.';
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE plan_restructure_instalments; DROP TABLE plan_restructures;

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE restructure_letter_number_seq; GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE restructure_letter_number_seq TO ${appDbUsername}; CREATE TABLE restructure_letters ( id uuid NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, created_by varchar(255), number varchar(32) NOT NULL, verification_code varchar(16) NOT NULL, restructure_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_restructures (id), transaction_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), offer_letter_id uuid REFERENCES offer_letters (id), buyer_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), seller_tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id), branch_id uuid REFERENCES branches (id), estate_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES estates (id), plot_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES plots (id), issued_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, company_name varchar(255) NOT NULL, company_rc_number varchar(64), company_address varchar(512), company_phone varchar(64), company_email varchar(255), company_website varchar(255), logo_file_id uuid REFERENCES stored_files (id), signature_file_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES stored_files (id), seal_file_id uuid REFERENCES stored_files (id), signatory_name varchar(120) NOT NULL, signatory_title varchar(120) NOT NULL, buyer_name varchar(255) NOT NULL, buyer_lines text[] NOT NULL, salutation varchar(300) NOT NULL, estate_name varchar(255) NOT NULL, estate_location varchar(512), plot_label varchar(255) NOT NULL, opening text NOT NULL, clauses text[] NOT NULL, closing text NOT NULL, sign_off varchar(80) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_restructure_letters_number UNIQUE (number), CONSTRAINT uq_restructure_letters_verification_code UNIQUE (verification_code), CONSTRAINT uq_restructure_letters_restructure UNIQUE (restructure_id), CONSTRAINT chk_restructure_letters_verification_code CHECK (verification_code ~ '^[0-9A-F]{16}$') ); CREATE INDEX idx_restructure_letters_buyer ON restructure_letters (buyer_user_id, issued_at DESC); REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON restructure_letters FROM ${appDbUsername}; COMMENT ON TABLE restructure_letters IS 'Phase 5c: restructure letters HomeTrue issued with a developer''s proposal: a copy of everything printed, never changed. Accepted, lapsed and the rest are derived from plan_restructures. See AGENTS.md, "Instalment plans", phase 5c.';
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE restructure_letters; DROP SEQUENCE restructure_letter_number_seq;
